text:
Liam: Hi @Maria — just closed BlueGrove Analytics (PO signed this morning). Quick handoff: they need SSO + VPC peering, a dedicated capacity estimate, and a private eval environment. Sales notes attached in the deal doc: https://redwood.atlassian.net/l/cp/BLUEGROVE-PO

Maria: Thanks Liam. Congrats! Can you paste the exact list of required networks/contacts? Need to start provisioning and schedule enablement.

Liam: Copying the checklist from the contract: 1) SAML SSO (Okta) with SCIM; 2) VPC peering to us (us-east-1); 3) Dedicated capacity: 2xA100 reserved + burst; 4) Log forwarding to their Splunk instance. Primary contacts: ops lead Dana (dana@bluegrove.com) and infra lead Marcus (marcus@bluegrove.com). Renewal discussion: 12-month term, auto-renew unless 60-day notice.

Maria: Good. I'm the CS owner. I'll run a kickoff with customer and product enablement. Raj / Tia — can you confirm provisioning ETA and whether we can support the requested burst with Dedicated?

Raj: Assigning support triage ticket now. Linking: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/CS-1234. Initial triage: SSO/SCIM should be standard. VPC peering requires networking contact and peering subnet info from BlueGrove. ETA for setup after we get network details: ~3 business days.

Tia: From eng side: Dedicated capacity 2xA100 reserved looks fine. Need to validate model footprints — which model family do they want pinned? Also need expected qps and max seq length for kernel tuning. If they want low-latency route policy we'll need canary routing staged.

Maria: I'll capture model/usage ask in the kickoff. Liam — please confirm if they expect to run private models or use our hosted catalog.

Liam: They plan to use our hosted models initially (gpt-redwood-xx), but want option to bring custom models later.

Maria: Ok. Action items: 
- Maria: schedule kickoff call with BlueGrove and send enablement onboarding link (owner: Maria; due: tomorrow EOD).
- Liam: share contact info and contract excerpt with infra (completed in thread).
- Raj: create network provisioning ticket and add network runbook checklist (owner: Raj; due: +2 business days).
- Tia: validate reserved capacity and put a capacity hold so we can guarantee burst (owner: Tia; due: +3 business days).

Raj: Created ticket CS-1234 and added preliminary checklist. Noted Splunk forwarder details needed: endpoint + token. Also flagged for support-oncall for peering window.

deploy-bot: Deployment window requested: 2025-09-12 02:00 UTC — please confirm.

Maria: BlueGrove prefers 02:00 UTC deploy windows. I'll confirm on the kickoff. Also want to capture training needs: they asked for a 90-minute workshop on prompt best practices and cost controls.

Tia: We should plan a short smoke test plan post-setup. Suggest steps: 1) SAML login validation; 2) basic gpt-redwood-xx generation end-to-end; 3) latency and token-cost sanity. I can write a quick test script.

Maria: Perfect. I'll open an enablement doc and map owners.

Liam: One more thing — flagged potential renewal risk: their usage profile shows spikes in month 10 historically. Contract has auto-renew, but finance wants a renewal touchpoint 90 days before term end. I'll add a calendar reminder.

Maria: I'll set a 90-day renewal checkpoint and tie it to monthly health metrics. We'll also capture feedback during the 30-day and 90-day enablement follow-ups.

Raj: FYI: if they bring custom models later, network egress/ingress and private registry access will need an extra security review — estimate 5 business days for review.

Maria: Noted. Final ask: can support/eng assign an owner for post-setup on-call for the first 14 days? We should avoid escalation noise.

Tia: I can be primary for the first 7 days; Raj covers support for triage. After that we transition to the standard oncall rotation.

Maria: Great — summarizing owners in the doc and will DM calendar invites. Thanks everyone. :tada: 

Liam: Thanks team — appreciate the quick turnaround.

(End of thread)
